name: stable-world
description: The physics half of ledger row #15, executed: the desired world as the STABLE SOLUTION of a fixed law. choice-lang compiled Choice into controlled branching and kept the marked world stable by construction (engineered programs, charge conserved — the language layer); what the ledger kept open was stability as physics. This repo is that law: a fixed dissipative channel (amplitude damping into the world bit, identity on the cargo) whose absorbing class is the marked world — quiet on what is already inside (deviation 0), globally attractive from anywhere (leakage (1-gamma)^k (1-p0) exact for every input), robust under law-error (asymptotic leakage <= eps/(1-(1-eps)(1-gamma)), exact bound + census), escape exactly impossible (the charge is monotone — the world is absorbing, not metastable). The membership charge becomes the law's LYAPUNOV function (increment gamma(1-V) exact; conserved exactly under engineered branch programs — one functional, two regimes, the discrete-Noether shape noted not claimed). The stability is PURCHASED: sector erasure pays h2(q) kT ln2 per run on the classical face (the settled #11 schedule, quoted from route-price), coherent face now PRICED on the authored diagonal Hamiltonian: dephasing preserves <H> exactly, so F(rho) - F(dephased rho) = kT ln2 * C_rel with C_rel the relative entropy of sector coherence; the law is an incoherent operation, so the value is dissipated, never harvested (pure straddlers pay the full bit; erasure at exactly twice the classical rate). The law selects the WORLD, never the CONTENTS (path-dependent).  The bath is no longer authored rates: the microscopic collision model (resonant Gibbs qubits, energy-conserving exchange) DERIVES detailed balance exactly, and the law itself is the family's zero-temperature member (TD decaying as e^{-beta dE}). And the coherent face is BANKABLE: the same exchange at theta = pi/2 against a ground weight reaches the law's k->infinity state in ONE step, conserves the full-basis coherence exactly, and banks the straddler's full sector bit on the weight with free-energy excess exactly kT ln2 — coherent protocols conserve what incoherent laws dissipate. The continuum limit is EXECUTED as a discrete convergence theorem: finite-coupling dynamics is exact and closed-form (populations with no higher corrections, block coherences by the 2x2 mixing matrix, sector coherence cos^n), the limit t = n sin^2(theta) only replaces geometrics by exponentials at O(t sin^2 theta), and the DAVIES coherence rate (gamma-down + gamma-up)/2 = 1/2 is restored exactly although every finite coupling is temperature-free. And the burn is AUDITED: the shortcut's output satisfies the exact three-term ledger C_total = C_register + C_weight + (I - J_c) with every term >= 0, and the inverse permutation restores the input bit-exactly — dissipation is the law's choice, not a necessity. The generator is now IDENTIFIED: the extraction limit is the Lindblad operator with the Davies rates (bounded at O(theta^2) elementwise, uniform over the state space as a census) — with the discrete convergence theorem this closes the weak-coupling limit to its machine-executable content. And the QSI boundary is split by the PHASE-ALIGNMENT bank: an incoherent controlled-phase controller raises the banked weight coherence to the l1 optimum exactly (triangle inequality attained), recovering up to 72.7% on opposite-phase states one-shot and QSI-free; the residual correlation coherence stays priced-and-cited. Visit v0.6.0 executed the BOUNDED faces: (1) the HOLDER's bounded catalyst — a Schmidt purification of the register rides the shortcut untouched (riding identity exact) and the harvest is a NESTED TRIANGLE (AT14's phase alignment the first layer, the classical record from measuring the memory the second, unlock up to 0.172 beyond alignment on the law's own trajectory states; the record matters exactly once the law has mixed the register), the bit ladder rides C_rel convexity (up to 0.469 bits unlocked), the coherent excess is CAPPED by the catalyst's dimension C_rel <= log2 d_c (tight at d_c = 2: the straddler's full bit on the 2-dim weight), the residual gap to kT ln2 * C_rel priced as data — finite catalyst, authored law, NO general asymptotic claim (WY16/OH02/LB21/CZJ24 cited); (2) the SECOND WORLD — two marked bits under one product law: single-world faces keep their exact geometrics on ARBITRARY entangled starts with the same increment identity, the join world is absorbing with leakage the exact union-with-intersection qA + qB - qAB (qAB(k) = (1-gamma)^{2k} c0), never a single geometric outside the trivial case, join-block programs conserve both worlds' charges while one-bit-block programs conserve only their own; (3) the ACCUMULATED law-error — time-dependent eps_t priced by the exact recursion B_t = B_{t-1}(1-eps_t)(1-gamma) + eps_t (constant-eps limit = AT4's bound, census with fresh random channels never exceeds it, an error schedule 49.5% off the constant-worst bill).   Boundaries honest: the law is authored (nature's instantiation not claimed), the thermal reading of escape now SHIPPED: detailed balance r = gamma e^{-dE/kT} makes the stationary occupancy the Boltzmann logistic 1/(1+e^{-beta dE}) exactly, the design rule beta dE >= ln(K gamma / delta) holds escape <= delta over horizon K, and the 5 GHz / 10 mK anchor reads 1 - 3.8e-11 (exact SI arithmetic). The checker enforces the board laws (eleven smuggling trials across eight laws SW1-SW8, incl. counterfeit catalyst-harvest claims beyond the cap and fake multi-world absorption certificates; plus the kernel-boundary trials of v0.7.0 — gamma, eps, horizons and rates refused by name at every public entry); the renderer refuses illegal boards. This visit (v0.7.0) is the code-quality wave: named DomainErrors at every public boundary, the dead kernel retired (~20 zero-reference exports, absorption-checked), duplicate constants single-sourced bit-identically, the books (package/lock/README) synced.
